hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ] && [ "$branch" != "HEAD" ] && [ "$branch" != "main" ] && [ "$branch" != "master" ]; then if git push -u origin "$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Auto-pushed $branch to origin\"}"; fi; fi
